title: Fans: one runaway server, killed; a check each cycle

text: The burner was the dev server of a worktree I had removed without stopping it first — 120 percent of a core watching a deleted folder. Killed. The other heat is transient: a minion's headless browser proving a page, and your own Chrome tab streaming the board. From now on every worktree is stopped before it is removed, and every mastermind cycle samples CPU for four seconds and kills any node over a full core whose folder is gone. The janitor still patrols every 15 minutes.
